A recent report announced a breakthrough in quantum network transmission that exploits existing optical‑fiber infrastructure. Researchers have demonstrated the ability to send quantum information across standard fibre cables, avoiding the need for specialized hardware or dedicated lines. This development paves the way for cost‑effective deployment of quantum communications by integrating seamlessly with current telecommunication networks.
